what_happened: Model-A step-path classification (time pinning, backward a-rigidity, forward a/b dichotomy, b-absorption, full jump-time classification) compiled clean in ~100 lines on first serious attempt, establishing the hardest geometric step of the HitPresented construction before planning.

lean-lsp MCP tools (lean_local_search, lean_hover_info, lean_leansearch, lean_loogle) were NOT exposed to this dispatch despite the dispatch file reporting the server registered and reachable; all declaration evidence was obtained by compiled '#check'/'#print axioms' via 'lake env lean' instead, which is a stronger evidence tier than hover but makes negative existence claims rest on grep rather than an LSP index.

All 17 Lean Challenge Statements for this plan were compile-checked against the live build before the plan was written (lake env lean on a scratch module): 16 sorry warnings, zero elaboration errors, so every pinned signature in the plan's Lean Challenge Statements section is type-correct at plan time rather than at first implementation dispatch.

Phase 1's Scope Hypothesis predicted ~15-25 lines added to Trace.lean; the actual addition is 44 lines. The two declarations plus their bodies are 12 lines; the overrun is entirely docstring prose that the phase's own task list mandates in detail (Hit-vs-trace weakening, why Probe735.not_presented does not transfer, fixture-only/forward-only/non-constructive discharge, no-bound disclaimer, Paper anchor lines on both declarations). The hypothesis undercounted its own documentation requirement rather than the code.

The phase-1 commit was BLOCKED by the pre-commit typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 gate: typst/generated/status.typ's committed formalsystem-line-count 347508 lagged the live count 347552 by exactly 44 -- this phase's own addition to Trace.lean. The --no-verify bypass is explicitly reserved for drift caused by ANOTHER writer, so it did not apply; the documented remedy (full lake build, typst-sync-check.sh --fix, stage typst/generated/status.typ) had to be run instead. Consequence for the rest of this plan: every later phase that adds Lean lines hits the same gate, and typst/generated/status.typ is NOT in the plan's declared file_scope, so each phase commit must stage a sixth path the plan does not list. Also cost two misfires on issue-record.sh itself: --class 'gate-collision' is outside the 15-class seed enum (warn-only) and --resolution is a closed enum (fixed_inline|worked_around|open), not free text.

Phase 2 transcription compiled green on the FIRST attempt, zero errors and zero warnings: the research dispatch's scratch file rigid745.lean was still present in the session scratchpad and every load-bearing tactic choice the report recorded (Int.induction_on zero/succ/pred, push_cast BEFORE the show-by-ring rewrite in bwd_a, simp only [not_exists] in place of push_neg, explicit IsStepPath hypothesis per theorem) transcribed without adjustment. No proof search was needed at all. All three #print axioms feet report exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound].

Phase 2 Scope Hypothesis overshoot: the plan hypothesized ~200-230 lines (header ~60, fixture ~50, classification ~110); the landed probe is 276 lines (header 65, fixture ~100, classification ~96). The overshoot is entirely in the fixture transcription: the plan's own task item enumerated 19 identifiers to transcribe, and the full jump well-definedness proof plus the RA_aa/RA_ab/RA_bb step facts those definitions require do not fit in 50 lines. Header and classification estimates were both accurate. No scope was added beyond the plan's enumerated task items; the estimate was low, not the work large.

Phase 3's Scope Hypothesis (80-120 added lines) undershot: 205 insertions / 9 deletions, net +196. The plan named the splice-to-step-path transport through pathFibreEquiv/seamOmegaEquiv as the suspected cost driver; it was NOT -- splice_classify landed in 29 lines and compiled on the first attempt. The driver is the read-out item itself: 'for each member of plusSubformulaClosure Fp plus clNow, give clTrace on stayA and on jump w explicitly' is 10 per-letter lemmas, and with the alphabet-exhaustion lemma, 4 membership facts, 2 stayA-falsity lemmas, 2 assembled iff forms and 2 function-level forms that is 21 declarations before any supporting material. The 10 pairwise-distinctness lemmas (unused in this phase, needed by phases 5-6 to case-split labOf's flag table) add a further ~22 lines.

splice_classify -- the phase's pinned Challenge statement and the step the plan flagged as the transport risk -- compiled green on the first attempt with no tactic search, because WorldHistory.path is WorldHistory.state by definition and seamOmegaEquiv's .symm carries the seam condition as its .2 field, so path_classify applied directly with no transport lemma needed. Re-deriving (plusSubformulaClosure Fp).card by #eval also confirmed the report's CARRIED-UNVERIFIED figure of 4 immediately.

The phase-3 heading was not marked [IN PROGRESS] before the proof work began; it went straight from [NOT STARTED] to [COMPLETED] in a single plan-file write at phase end. The marker's purpose is crash recovery, so writing it retroactively after the phase was already green would have been false rather than useful. Stated here rather than silently skipped. No other step of the phase-checkpoint protocol was omitted.

exists_splice_eq's first form used 'show' to state the symm_apply_apply goal explicitly; the show forced elaboration at implicit transparency and produced an application type mismatch between {sigma // sigma.state t = stayA.state t} and Presheaf.StabFibre FA.toTaskFrame.toFibre.toTaskFrame t (stayA.state t), so the following rw found no pattern. Dropping the show and using congrArg Subtype.val ((seamOmegaEquiv t (stayA.state t)).symm_apply_apply <sigma, h>) compiled first try.

The pinned Challenge signature binds (hk : 1 <= k) but the truncation argument genuinely does not use it (HitCl is defined at every depth), so Lean's unusedVariables linter warned -- colliding with the phase's zero-warnings bar and its verbatim-pinned-signature bar. Resolved by a declaration-scoped 'set_option linter.unusedVariables false in' plus a docstring paragraph saying why hk is carried, rather than renaming the binder to _hk (which would have altered the pinned signature).
